methods: Keyboard-only operation and a screen reader check with NVDA 2026.2 and Firefox on Windows 11, by the vendor's developers.

criteria.label: Non-text Content
criteria.remarks: Every image has a text alternative, and decorative images are hidden from screen readers.

criteria.label: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
criteria.remarks: The product has no audio-only or video-only content.

criteria.label: Captions (Prerecorded)
criteria.remarks: The product has no prerecorded video.

criteria.label: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
criteria.remarks: The product has no prerecorded video.

criteria.label: Captions (Live)
criteria.remarks: The product has no live video.

criteria.label: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
criteria.remarks: The product has no prerecorded video.

criteria.label: Info and Relationships
criteria.remarks: Headings, lists, tables and form fields are marked up as such.

criteria.label: Meaningful Sequence
criteria.remarks: The reading order of every page follows its visual order.

criteria.label: Sensory Characteristics
criteria.remarks: No instruction relies on shape or position alone.

criteria.label: Orientation
criteria.remarks: Every page works in portrait and landscape.

criteria.label: Identify Input Purpose
criteria.remarks: Fields for the user's name, email and address name their purpose.

criteria.label: Use of Color
criteria.remarks: Overdue invoices are marked by a word as well as a colour.

criteria.label: Audio Control
criteria.remarks: The product plays no audio.

criteria.label: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.remarks: Body text meets the ratio. The "Draft" badge on unsent invoices measures 3.1 to 1.

criteria.label: Resize Text
criteria.remarks: Text can be enlarged to 200 percent with browser zoom without loss of content.

criteria.label: Images of Text
criteria.remarks: The product shows no images of text.

criteria.label: Reflow
criteria.remarks: Every page reflows to a width of 320 CSS pixels.

criteria.label: Non-text Contrast
criteria.remarks: Controls and focus indicators meet the 3 to 1 ratio.

criteria.label: Content on Hover or Focus
criteria.remarks: Tooltips stay while hovered, and Escape dismisses them.

criteria.label: Keyboard
criteria.remarks: Every function can be operated from a keyboard.

criteria.label: No Keyboard Trap
criteria.remarks: Focus never becomes trapped, in dialogs included.

criteria.label: Character Key Shortcuts
criteria.remarks: The product has no single-character keyboard shortcuts.

criteria.label: Timing Adjustable
criteria.remarks: The session warns before it times out and can be extended.

criteria.label: Pause, Stop, Hide
criteria.remarks: Nothing on the product's pages moves or updates on its own.

criteria.label: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
criteria.remarks: Nothing on the product's pages flashes.

criteria.label: Bypass Blocks
criteria.remarks: A "Skip to content" link starts every page.

criteria.label: Page Titled
criteria.remarks: Every page has a title naming the page and the product.

criteria.label: Multiple Ways
criteria.remarks: Every page can be reached from the menu, and from search.

criteria.label: Focus Visible
criteria.remarks: The product's style sheet removes the browser's focus outline, and nothing replaces it.

criteria.label: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
criteria.remarks: The page's header never covers the focused control.

criteria.label: Focus Appearance
criteria.remarks: Level AAA; not evaluated.

criteria.label: Pointer Gestures
criteria.remarks: No function uses a path-based or multipoint gesture.

criteria.label: Pointer Cancellation
criteria.remarks: Controls act when the pointer is released.

criteria.label: Motion Actuation
criteria.remarks: No function is operated by moving the device.

criteria.label: Dragging Movements
criteria.remarks: No function needs dragging.

criteria.label: Target Size (Minimum)
criteria.remarks: Every target is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels.

criteria.label: Language of Parts
criteria.remarks: The product's text is all in one language.

criteria.label: Consistent Navigation
criteria.remarks: The menu is in the same place and order on every page.

criteria.label: Consistent Help
criteria.remarks: The help link is in the same place on every page.

criteria.label: Error Identification
criteria.remarks: A field in error is named, and the error is described in text.

criteria.label: Error Suggestion
criteria.remarks: Errors say what was expected, such as a date's format.

criteria.label: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
criteria.remarks: An invoice can be reviewed before it is sent and recalled for ten minutes after.

criteria.label: Redundant Entry
criteria.remarks: The product never asks for the same information twice in one process.

criteria.label: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
criteria.remarks: Signing in allows a password manager and pasting, and asks no cognitive test.

criteria.label: Name, Role, Value
criteria.remarks: Every control is a native one, or exposes its name, role and state.

criteria.label: Status Messages
criteria.remarks: Saved and sent messages are announced as status messages.
